libs.note: BH-8226. The sign-in step of the web-task lane: on the run's vault site only, and only when that site is on the allow-list, it types the username and password through type_secret (bin/lib/web-secret-action.mjs), submits the form and checks that the form is gone. Slice C1 of #8226 applies it with lib_env_apply web-signin in the web-task lane.

knobs.note: How long the sign-in step waits for the page to load after a submit. Past it the step answers `error: sign-in timed out after <n>s`. A value that is not an integer in 5..120 makes createSignIn throw; it is never clamped. Read by createSignIn as env WEB_TASK_SIGNIN_TIMEOUT_S, fallback 20.

How many sign-in attempts one agent run may make. 1 = one try, because a repeated wrong password can lock a real account. Past the cap the step answers `refused: sign-in refused (attempt cap <n>)` and the run stops. A value that is not an integer in 1..3 makes createSignIn throw; it is never clamped. Read by createSignIn as env WEB_TASK_SIGNIN_ATTEMPTS, fallback 1.
